item.title: Forget the goals and PBs – just enjoy it | Brief letters
item.summary: Recreational sport | Happy WhatsApps | Woodlice woes | Guessing game | Lost in film What happened to the joy of recreational sport ( ‘I spent a week crying. I’ve never had an injury in my life!’ Why do so many fitness fans end up needing surgery?, 3 August )? It’s like modern life – goal and target-oriented. PBs, how many laps, lengths, miles? Have to get the laps in, even if the back is killing me. Why? Is it about bragging rights? As a lifelong sports and exercise enthusiast aged 77 and still loving it, I really don’t understand the motivation for wilfully destroying your body in the name of sport. Barbara Smyth Cheltenham, Gloucestershire • My experience of WhatsApp blue ticks differs ( Letters, 29 July ). During the Covid pandemic, every day I rejoiced in seeing the blue tick on a message from a family member who lived alone and had Covid: they were still alive.
